items.quote: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth
items.claim: Ephron lived among the children of Heth.

items.quote: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
items.claim: Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham publicly, in front of the children of Heth and everyone who went in at his city's gate.
items.mechanism: public speech before witnesses at the city gate

items.quote: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.
items.claim: Ephron offered to give Abraham the field and the cave in it, in front of his own people, so Abraham could bury his dead.
items.object: the field and the cave therein
items.mechanism: a gift offered in front of the people as witnesses
